The '''Rydar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Antemeridian sector/Legends|Antemeridian sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], and contained the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Rydar II]], the original [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Ranat/Legends|Ranat]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
